about_hero_desc: Nameer is a digital platform of Senabil Foundation for Youth and Development, connecting donors directly with families and orphans in Gaza under full field supervision and dignity-preserving transparency.
about_story_p1: Nameer is a digital arm of Senabil Foundation for Youth and Development, designed to make direct giving easier while keeping the field and institutional oversight that ensures support reaches those who need it.
about_story_p2: Through Nameer we publish verified support opportunities, follow field verification and media review, and give donors clear impact reporting without compromising beneficiary privacy or dignity.
about_vision_desc: For Nameer to be the safest and most transparent channel for direct giving in Gaza, so support reaches those who need it with dignity and full clarity for donors.
about_mission_desc: Enable orphans and vulnerable families to access trusted support opportunities, and connect them with donors through a technical and field system under Senabil Foundation.
about_goal_1_desc: Shorten the distance between donor and beneficiary with full institutional oversight.
about_goal_2_desc: Present needs respectfully while protecting privacy and dignity.
about_goal_3_desc: Field documentation and reports that help donors see the effect of their giving.
about_why_1: Officially part of Senabil Foundation — not an independent entity.
about_why_2: Field verification then media review before publishing.
about_why_3: Direct connection while protecting privacy and dignity.
about_why_4: Transparency and reports that help you follow the impact.
about_value_1_desc: We consider your donation a trust on our shoulders, for which we are accountable before God and people.
about_value_2_desc: Field documentation and periodic reports that always put you at the heart of the action.
about_value_3_desc: Protecting beneficiary dignity first and last across every stage of support.
about_value_4_desc: Organized institutional work under Senabil with clear review and publishing standards.
about_cta_desc: Whether you are a donor or a beneficiary, your contribution helps build a safer and more transparent giving path.
faq_subtitle: Short answers to the most common questions about Nameer
faq_q1: Is Nameer part of Senabil Foundation?
faq_a1: Yes. Nameer is a platform of Senabil Foundation for Youth and Development and operates under its policies and supervision.
faq_a2: Requests go through initial review, field verification, then media content review before approval and publishing.
faq_q3: Can I donate or request support on the platform?
faq_a3: Yes. You can register as a donor to support available opportunities, or as a beneficiary to submit a request subject to review and verification.
faq_q4: Where can I follow transparency and reports?
faq_a4: From the Transparency & Reports page on the platform, plus implementation updates linked to each opportunity after support.

transparency_hero_desc: At Nameer, we believe transparency is not just reports, but a commitment we make to every donor who placed their trust in us, ensuring every cent reaches those in need with honesty and integrity.
transparency_journey_title: How Do We Ensure Your Giving Reaches?
transparency_journey_desc: A strict supervisory system from the moment of transfer to the moment of documented receipt.
transparency_step_1_desc: Each case is inspected in the field by our specialized team and all official documents are documented before publishing.
transparency_step_2_desc: All communication and agreement processes are conducted under management supervision to ensure donor safety and case privacy.
transparency_step_3_desc: The receipt is uploaded by the family, and the case is not closed until the full arrival of the amount is confirmed.
transparency_report_1_desc: Full summary of all revenues and expenses during 2025, certified by an internal auditor.
transparency_report_2_desc: Distribution of aid and how your donations contribute to changing the reality of needy families in the field.
transparency_report_3_desc: Periodic certificate from independent legal accounting offices to ensure the neutrality of financial reports.
transparency_trust_desc: We don't just provide reports; we allow donors (under certain conditions) to directly communicate with cases under our supervision, to see for themselves where their money goes. This is the highest level of transparency.
transparency_trust_policy: All your donations are protected by a strict privacy policy.
transparency_faq_desc: The Integrity and Compliance team is available to respond to any complaint or question regarding financial data.

register_beneficiary_contract_body:
You acknowledge that Sanabil Youth and Development Foundation established the “Nameer” platform as a channel for communication and presenting humanitarian cases in line with the foundation’s objectives.

You acknowledge that registering as a beneficiary on the platform and publishing any cases or requests does not constitute a binding promise by the foundation or the platform to provide financial or in-kind assistance; any potential support is subject to review, verification, available resources, and the foundation’s approved policies.

You acknowledge that the platform remains under testing and development ahead of its official launch, and that services, interfaces, workflows, or terms may change or be temporarily interrupted without individual notice, as the foundation deems appropriate for platform operations.

You confirm that you have read and understood the above, expressly agree to it, and consent to proceed with registration and use accordingly.
